question: How often do the groups meet?

group.title: Reading comprehension
group.setup: In many villages, women's self-help groups meet once a week to save small amounts together. Each member puts in a fixed sum, and the group lends from this common fund to members who need money for a sewing machine, a cow or school fees. Because the borrowers are neighbours who meet every week, repayment rates are often very high. Banks have noticed this and now lend to such groups as a whole. The weekly meeting does more than move money: members say it gives them confidence to speak in public and to deal with officials.
